chinese_missing_policy: 31023 name and kilogibblometer description are absent in the user patch. Retain original English in both locales rather than invent a Chinese translation.
unknown_data_policy: Known original automatic material components only. Unrecorded pressure plate tags, comparators and instrument item data are not replaced with arbitrary ingredients or guessed quantities.

runtime_changes.wrench: reset measuring side to opposite new display
runtime_changes.monkey_wrench: select any valid side except display; native permission/electric charge checks and10000 source tool-return cost
runtime_changes.electrometer: ElectricWire.lastWattage and voltage*amperage; never generic machine stored energy
runtime_changes.gibbl: Raw CompressionSensorSource value/max, divided by1000 or1000000; no generic fluid-handler fallback
